'''Khulna–Mongla Port line''' is a {{convert|65|km|adj=mid|4=long}}under-construction  [[5 ft 6 in gauge railway|broad gauge]] railway to connect the country with [[Mongla Port]]. The [[Rupsha Rail Bridge]] is on this proposed line.<ref>{{cite web|last1= Munima Sultana, The Financial Express|title=Khulna-Mongla rail project cost set to escalate|date=25 May 2018|url=http://www.today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/trade-market/khulna-mongla-rail-project-cost-set-to-escalate-1527186114|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180910000152/http://www.today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/trade-market/khulna-mongla-rail-project-cost-set-to-escalate-1527186114|archive-date=2018-09-10}}</ref>
